mapper.insert: insert into mq_dead_letter(message_id, queue, payload, state, retry_count, create_time, update_time) values (#{messageId}, #{queue}, #{payload}, #{state}, #{retryCount}, now(), now())
mapper.update: update mq_dead_letter set state = 'replayed', update_time = now() where id = #{id} and state = 'pending'
update mq_dead_letter set retry_count = retry_count + 1, state = case when retry_count + 1 >= 5 then 'manual_pending' else 'pending' end, update_time = now() where id = #{id}
update mq_dead_letter set state = 'manual_pending', update_time = now() where id = #{id}
